title: Pan-Seared Hake with Polish Pilaf
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring pan-seared hake served with a side of polish pilaf. Perfect for a light dinner or lunch.
instructions: Season the hake fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the hake fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the hake from the skillet and set aside.
Add the polish pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the remaining winey sauce.
Serve the hake on top of the polish pilaf.
